reason: Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to run live API calls. Evaluation needs network access to api.deepseek.com and a valid API key with balance.

prompts.name: basic-search-cite
prompts.prompt: Search for "DeepSeek V4 release" and give me a summary with citations. I want to know the key features, release date, and where to find the model. Cite each claim with the source domain in markdown link format like [github.com](url).

expectations.text: search tool is invoked with query "DeepSeek V4 release"
Response cites sources using [domain](url) markdown format
Summary includes key features, release date, and model availability
Results sorted or filtered by rerank_score/authority

prompts.name: operator-search
prompts.prompt: Find recent information about DeepSeek only from GitHub or HuggingFace, in English, published after January 2025. Exclude any advertising or marketing pages. Show me the top 5 results with their relevance scores.

expectations.text: search query includes site:github.com OR site:huggingface.co
Results show rerank_score and authority fields

prompts.name: full-content-fetch
prompts.prompt: Search for "DeepSeek API pricing" and get the full content of the most authoritative result (authority >= 3). Then also fetch the DeepSeek API docs pricing page directly to compare.

expectations.text: Result with highest authority >= 3 is identified
Fetch API called on the selected result's URL
Both responses contain Markdown content in content field

prompts.name: error-handling
prompts.prompt: Try to search with an invalid count parameter (100) and show me how the skill handles the error. Then do a valid search to confirm it still works.

expectations.text: First search attempt with count=100 triggers 400 error
Error message surfaced to user with actionable guidance
Second search with valid count=10 succeeds

prompts.name: rate-limit-retry
prompts.prompt: Search for "test query" — if you hit a rate limit or server error, retry automatically up to 3 times with backoff. Report whether it succeeded or failed after retries.
